title: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 GGUF on llama.cpp (ggml-org)
slug_note: The official MXFP4 weights as one 63.4 GB GGUF, served by llama.cpp.

variation.quant_detail: MXFP4, 63.39 GB (gpt-oss-120b-MXFP4.gguf); the repo also holds an EAGLE3 draft model
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot `llama serve -hf` resolved on 2026-10-25; it picked the MXFP4 GGUF, not the eagle3 drafter files in the same repo

engine.config: llama serve with the repo default

requirements.notes: Estimate: the 63.4 GB file plus KV cache. Not measured.

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet.
`llama serve` is the newer unified llama.cpp command used on the ggml-org card; on older builds the equivalent server binary is `llama-server -hf ...`.

On DGX OS 7.4 (Ubuntu 24.04) a source build of llama.cpp has no HTTPS unless OpenSSL headers are present, and `-hf` then fails with "HTTPS is not supported ... model download failed". Run `sudo apt install libssl-dev` before building (found 2026-10-25).
Works as written on a DGX Spark once llama.cpp is built with OpenSSL (2026-10-25). The command shown downloads the model on first run.
Same box, same test script: 54.3 vs 43.4 tok/s for the Ollama gpt-oss:120b tag (short prompt), even though Ollama runs llama.cpp underneath. Cause not yet isolated.
